result.rationale: Keep one Rio Grande LNG PortCo, but correct ownership. GIP, GIC and Mubadala acquired Phase 1 equity at the 2023-07-12 close and reinvested in Trains 4/5; Mubadala is in scope. BlackRock's 2024 GIP acquisition changed the manager's parent, not the RGLNG vehicles, so no separate BlackRock period or GEPIF III attribution is supported. XRG made partial GIP sell-downs, not a full exit.
